# tag | extra CLI args for testdata/specs/errf_flags.json (one case per line). Read by scripts/gen-golden.sh and the Go tests.
k_not_number | --k x
k_missing | --k
null_reps_negative | --null-reps -1
seed_float | --seed 1.5
top_bad | --top many
method_unknown | --method qr
unknown_flag | --frobnicate 1
boundary_missing_file | --boundary testdata/specs/does-not-exist.boundary.json
k_zero | --k 0
